definition: The fixed order a play is processed in: legality > placement > interrupt > resolve > stop_time > score.
window: Every play, including Stop Time extra plays.
does: Decides which effect works when two apply: legality first, then Unstoppable vs Interrupt, then Ward vs Dim.
does_not: Interrupts are not themselves interruptible; there is no stack deeper than one.

contrast.provenance: Resolution order is the rule; provenance is the record that it was followed.
